_comment: US-0 canonical roster for the installed-vs-repository self-check. This file declares ONLY what the repo bytes cannot tell us: whether a script is expected to be installed on a coordinator machine, and which conformance checks are deliberately waived and why. Everything derivable from disk - @version, @match, @updateURL, @downloadURL, content hash - is read from the shipped file on every run and is NOT duplicated here, so this file cannot drift on those. scripts/test-manifest-ledger.js enforces that this roster and the *.user.js files on disk agree in BOTH directions: a new script with no row here, or a row here with no file, is a red build. Waivers are per-check and must carry a reason.

waived.namespace: Uses https://broadwaynational.com/bwn where the other 20 use broadwaynational.bwn. NOT normalized on purpose: Tampermonkey's identity key is (@namespace, @name), so changing it mints a new script and orphans every installed copy into a manual reinstall. Recorded as a deliberate exception, not drift.
